violations.text: The ceiling in the kitchen area is covered with tiles that are not smooth, durable, and easily cleanable. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 04/21/2025

The quaternary ammonium concentration in the sanitizing solution of the 3-bay sink was less than 200 parts per million (ppm). According to the manufacturer's use directions, the concentration of the quaternary ammonium must be 200-400 ppm. PIC added additional sanitizer and retested. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/17/2026

Per interview with staff, mac & cheese and mashed potatoes are reheated using hot-holding unit. Mac & cheese and mashed potatoes were observed reheated between 99-112F. PIC informed and reheated items in microwave for hot-holding. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/17/2026

Various items were observed not marked with the date of preparation. Ready-to-eat time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods prepared in the establishment and held for more than 24 hours must be marked with the date of preparation. New Violation. Correct By: 08/17/2026

Per interview with staff, dredging flour mixture, previously used in contact with raw chicken and stored at ambient temperature, is disposed of at the end of the day. PIC informed that mixture must be disposed of every 4 hours after in contact with raw chicken. New Violation. Correct By: 08/17/2026

Working containers used for storing chemicals taken from bulk supplies were not marked with the common name of the chemical. PIC wrote names in. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/17/2026

The presence of rodents are not controlled as evidenced by droppings under register area. The presence of insects, rodents, and other pests must be controlled by routinely inspecting the premises for evidence of pests, using acceptable methods to control pests, eliminating harborage conditions, and routinely inspecting incoming shipments of food and supplies. New Violation. Correct By: 08/17/2026

The door to the outside, located in the storage shed, is not tight-fitting. Outer openings of a food establishment must be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by tight-fitting doors. New Violation. Correct By: 08/31/2026
Chicken wings were observed stored on the floor in the walk-in cooler. Food must be stored at least 6 inches above the floor. New Violation. Correct By: 08/17/2026
Inspector observed single use items stored on the floor in the kitchen and storage room. Items must be stored 6 or more inches from the floor. New Violation. Correct By: 08/17/2026
Prep unit located in the kitchen area was not in good repair (dripping water). New Violation. Correct By: 08/17/2026
The non-food contact surfaces of the deep freezer chest units have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, ice, and other debris. New Violation. Correct By: 08/17/2026
Inspector observed leak under 3 bay sink. New Violation. Correct By: 08/17/2026

The sink used for food preparation is lacking an air gap. A direct connection must not exist between the sewage system and a drain originating from equipment in which food is placed. New Violation. Correct By: 08/31/2026
The ceiling in the kitchen/service area is covered with tiles that are not smooth, durable, and easily cleanable. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 04/21/2025

The walk-in cooler is in poor repair (dripping water). The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. PIC informed not to store items under drip until fixed. New Violation. Correct By: 08/17/2026

Unnecessary and/or non-functional equipment or items were observed in the along side of storage shed area. Establishments shall be kept free of unnecessary and/or non-functional equipment and litter to prevent harborage conditions. New Violation. Correct By: 09/07/2026
The ceiling in the (kitchen) area is covered with tiles that are not smooth, durable, and easily cleanable. New Violation. Correct By: 04/21/2025
The establishment does not have a written procedure for cleaning vomit and diarrhea. Inspector provided RIDOH guidance at inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 04/02/2024

The hand-washing sink in the kitchen was blocked by various dishes and utensils. A hand-washing sink shall be accessible at all times for employee use. PIC removed items during inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 04/02/2024

Raw animal foods (whole shell eggs) were observed stored above ready-to-eat foods (bananas) in the walk-in refrigerator. Raw animal foods must be separated from raw ready-to-eat food such as vegetables during storage. PIC moved during inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 04/02/2024

Beverages were observed stored on the floor in the storage room. Food must be stored at least 6 inches above the floor. PIC placed beverages on rack during inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 04/02/2024
Food storage containers observed with old labels/stickers preventing the containers from being properly cleaned and sanitized. New Violation. Correct By: 04/02/2024
Leak was observed at the 3-bay sink during inspection. PIC scheduled service during inspection. New Violation. Correct By: 04/16/2024
Hot hold unit located in the kitchen area was not in good repair. Drain plug was missing on the unit. PIC stated foods will be mostly prepared to order. New Violation. Correct By: 02/07/2024
The receptacle in the women's toilet room is lacking a cover. A toilet room used by females shall be provided with a covered receptacle for sanitary napkins. New Violation. Correct By: 02/14/2024
